title: Contax 645 AF Medium Format System
purpose: High-key fine art wedding and editorial medium-format film portraiture with legendary Zeiss Planar 80mm f/2 creamy separation and soft pastel color.

sensor_and_optics.camera_system: Contax 645 AF Medium Format Film Camera
sensor_and_optics.full_frame_equivalent: ~50mm normal field of view with massive medium format negative area
sensor_and_optics.iso_base: Fujicolor Pro 400H color negative film (overexposed +1 stop)
sensor_and_optics.dynamic_range: 14 stops color negative latitude with luminous highlight retention
sensor_and_optics.shutter: Electronic focal plane shutter up to 1/4000s

lighting_and_exposure.primary_lighting: Bright diffused open shade daylight, overexposed +1 stop for airy high-key luminescence
lighting_and_exposure.light_transport: Soft pastel color palette, gentle micro-contrast roll-off, ethereal luminous skin tones with creamy bokeh

surface_rendering: Medium format analog resolution: smooth organic skin texture without digital over-sharpening
Soft pastel color palette with gentle highlight roll-off and mint-green/lavender undertones
Zeiss T* coating acutance with zero chromatic fringing
depth_and_optics: Extremely shallow 645 depth of field at f/2: razor-thin focal plane with buttery background melt
Dreamy subject isolation characteristic of Zeiss Planar 80mm f/2 optical formula
Authentic analog film softness without artificial blur filters

execution_directive: Enforce medium format color film photograph, 80mm lens wide open at f/2, extremely shallow depth of field, overexposed one stop for bright airy high-key tones, soft pastel color, creamy background blur, shot on Contax 645 with Fuji Pro 400H.
